text: 瑞典议会选举13日上午开始投票。此次选举将产生新一届全国议会，并影响未来瑞典政府组成和政策走向。瑞典广播电台12日公布的大选前最后一轮民调结果显示，社会民主党以28.6%的支持率位居第一；普遍被认为属极右翼的瑞典民主党支持率为18.3%，位居第二；现任首相乌尔夫·克里斯特松领导的温和党以16.8%的支持率位居第三。瑞典议会共有349个议席，每4年举行一次选举。（新华社）
text_en: Sweden's parliamentary election voting began on the morning of the 13th. The election will produce a new national parliament and will influence the future composition of Sweden's government and policy direction. The final pre-election poll released by Swedish Radio on the 12th showed the Social Democrats in first place with 28.6% support; the Sweden Democrats, widely regarded as far-right, in second place with 18.3% support; and the Moderate Party led by incumbent Prime Minister Ulf Kristersson in third place with 16.8% support. Sweden's parliament has 349 seats, with elections held every four years. (Xinhua News Agency)
